description:
O’Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are pleased to offer for sale to magnificent, detached residence in an ideal location in the popular Knocknacarra area.

Donkell is situated on Ballymoneen Road, adjacent to Knocknacarra church. 

Originally constructed in 2002, the quality detached home comprises of approximately 121.33 sq.m over two stories & is excellently presented by the current owners. 

The ground floor is arranged between a large living area to the front with feature fireplace & leads to a modern kitchen with tiled finishing. 

The back of the house offers a spacious room that with plentiful window space allowing the room to avail of plentiful natural light due to the sought after westerly aspect. This room could be well utilised as a downstairs bedroom. 

The ground floor area is completed via a downstairs bathroom, separate utility space & ample storage. 

Upstairs offers a large landing with plentiful adjacent storage. Originally comprising of three bedrooms upstairs, the current layout is arranged between two large bedrooms, both with fitted wardrobes & availing of their own en-suites. 

Externally the house offers a cobbled patio encompassing the house with mature planting & hedging. Two sheds are situated on situated in the garden, both with electricity connections. 

The house is offered to the market in excellent condition with quality finished & features throughout such as concrete flooring, new combi boiler, instant hot water & well insulated attic

Donkell house is ideally located within the Knocknacarra residential area. Situated on Ballymoneen Road, adjacent to Knocknacarra Church, with quality transport links to all areas of Galway City are on your doorstep.

Local amenities such as Tesco supermarket and Gateway Retail Park are within walking distance. 

Several outdoor landmarks are within walking distance including Rusheen Bay & Woods, Silverstrand, McGrath’s Field & Cappagh Playing Fields. 

Donkell will be an appealing property for a variety of purchasers looking for quality condition in ideal location.

Viewing is highly recommended.
